description: Na₅MnO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.44 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.43 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.68 Å. Mn is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MnO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-1.89 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven Na and one Mn atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Mn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Mn pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 67-68°. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Mn atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Mn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-49°.
